# Virtual Gyans

> Virtual Gyans (https://www.virtualgyans.me) is an interactive tech learning and career development platform founded by Md Irfan. It offers Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA) coding challenges, an AI-powered ATS resume builder, company placement roadmaps, and IT interview preparation blueprints.

## Official Resources & Media
- Official Website: https://www.virtualgyans.me
- Official YouTube Channel: https://www.youtube.com/c/virtualgyans
- Official GitHub: https://github.com/mdirfancse2023

## Core Platform Features
- **Company Placement Roadmaps**: Tech interview blueprints, onboarding guides, and placement preparation for top IT service and product companies (TCS NQT, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Cognizant, Capgemini, Amazon).
- **AI ATS Resume Builder & Analyzer**: Free ATS-compliant resume creation, keyword score optimization, job description matcher, and PDF export.
- **Code Playground & Online Compiler**: Online IDE supporting Java 8 (Stream API, Lambda expressions, Multithreading), Python 3, C++, JavaScript, and SQL window functions with LeetCode-style problem sets.
- **Interactive Tech Courses**: Structured courses and notes on Spring Boot 3, Microservices, System Design (HLD & LLD), React, Angular, and Core Computer Science subjects.
- **YouTube Tutorials**: Video masterclasses, coding walkthroughs, and interview guidance hosted on the Virtual Gyans YouTube channel.
